title: Unrelated image metadata
content:
Working image sources should take precedence over unrelated or undocumented attributes. Responsive images should also retain their own source sets.

![First](https://example.com/backup.jpg)

![Second](https://example.com/alternate.jpg)

![Third](https://example.com/original.jpg)

![Responsive](https://example.com/unrelated.jpg)

The accompanying text explains why metadata must not replace a working source merely because it contains another image URL.
